name: Worpswede (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, white and green in the proportions 1:3:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Worpswede (crowns and a fleur-de-lis on red above a shield on green).
history: The flag is divided twice into green, white and green in the ratio 1:3:1 with the arms at the centre.

features.role: Worpswede arms — crowns, fleur-de-lis and shield
